metadata.title: Whitham Deformations of Nodal Spectral Curves of the Sinh-Gordon Equation
metadata.abstract: Spectral curves of constant mean curvature tori in Euclidean three-space are real hyperelliptic curves carrying two meromorphic differentials with integral periods. Deformations that preserve the periods, called Whitham deformations, are well understood for nonsingular curves, where the isoperiodic sets are manifolds. We extend Whitham deformations to curves with ordinary double points that are fixed by the real involution. At such curves the isoperiodic sets remain manifolds and are transverse to the curves with double points, so Whitham deformations can change the genus of the spectral curve. We describe how the double points open, and when the derivative of the normalized Willmore energy vanishes at a nodal curve. By inserting double points, we show that every value of a discrete invariant of the isoperiodic sets found in previous work occurs.

analysis.topic: 黎曼、亚黎曼、Finsler及特殊几何结构
analysis.progressType: 节点谱曲线的跨亏格 Whitham 变形
analysis.workSummary: 将 CMC 环面谱曲线的等周期 Whitham 变形扩展到普通双点被实对合固定的曲线。作者证明等周期集在这些节点处仍为流形，并横截双点曲线层，因而变形可改变谱曲线亏格；描述节点打开与归一化 Willmore 能量导数消失条件。
techniques: 普通节点与实超椭圆谱曲线
节点插入与离散不变量
analysis.breakthrough: 通过插入双点实现此前等周期集离散不变量的每个取值，并连接不同谱亏格。
analysis.limitations: 只针对所述实对合固定的普通双点，不能自动包括任意奇异谱曲线；谱曲线亏格改变不等同原始环面拓扑改变。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。
